description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.
The ID of the application group in CloudMonitor.

description.zh: 部署地域ID（即资源所在地域ID）。
description.en: The ID of the region in which the related sources reside.
The description of the application group.

description.zh: 标签键，必须和标签值（ImportTagValue）同时传入或都不传入，不能只传入一个。ImportTagKey和ImportTagValue 都不填则默认为app-{ApplicationName}（应用名称）。
description.en: The key of the tag. You must set both the ImportTagKey and the ImportTagValue parameters, or leave both of them empty. If you do not set the ImportTagKey and ImportTagValue parameters, the application name is used for this parameter by default.

description.zh: 标签值，必须和标签键（ImportTagKey）同时传入或都不传入，不能只传入一个。ImportTagKey和ImportTagValue 都不填则默认为{Name}（应用分组名称）。
description.en: The value of the tag. You must set both the ImportTagKey and the ImportTagValue parameters, or leave both of them empty. If you do not set the ImportTagKey and ImportTagValue parameters, the application group name is used for this parameter by default.
The name of the application group.
The region ID. Set the value to cn-hangzhou.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos create-application-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --description ApplicationGroup --deploy-region-id cn-hangzhou --import-tag-key k1 --import-tag-value v1 --name MyApplicationGroup --client-token - --application-name MyApplication --cms-group-id 218026174 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos CreateApplicationGroup --region cn-hangzhou --ImportTagValue v1 --DeployRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Description ApplicationGroup --ApplicationName MyApplication --ImportTagKey k1 --CmsGroupId 218026174 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '-' --Name MyApplicationGroup
